text: Chemistry is a natural science that studies the composition, structure, properties, change laws and energy conversion of substances. It serves as a bridge connecting mathematics, physics, life sciences, materials science and other disciplines. From daily activities such as clothing, food, housing and transportation (such as synthetic fiber clothing, drug research, food additives) to high-tech fields (such as new energy materials, chip manufacturing, aerospace fuel), the presence of chemistry is everywhere. It not only explores the "origin" of substances but also promotes the "reconstruction" of the material world by humans.
